$comment: KursoKo share character card — v1 schema for 6 RIASEC archetype exports
asset_set: Results share collectible — one PNG per primary RIASEC archetype

global_rules.figure: full-body young adult — head to feet visible inside frame
global_rules.style: flat vector illustration, Corporate Memphis–inspired, lineless — no ink outline on figure; shapes defined by flat color fills and minimal side cel-shade only
global_rules.face: minimal friendly face — small dot eyes, tiny nose tick, simple curved mouth; not photorealistic
global_rules.background: fully transparent PNG outside the border stroke — no white fill, no paper color, no floor box, no gradient backdrop
global_rules.border: wonky skewed rounded quadrilateral frame — medium-weight solid stroke in RIASEC primary accent; interior transparent except character and props
global_rules.locale: neutral global — SHS to college age, diverse cast across the six cards
forbidden_on_image: anime cel with heavy black outline
global_rules.naming: {archetype_id}.png — builder, pathfinder, creator, guardian, visionary, strategist

border_frame_taxonomy.plain_language: A soft sticker-like frame that is NOT a straight rectangle — left edge nearly vertical, top edge slopes gently down left-to-right, right edge tapers inward toward the top, bottom edge slopes gently up left-to-right; all four corners heavily rounded like a inflated bubble
border_frame_taxonomy.stroke: solid 5px equivalent at 640px scale, no interior fill
border_frame_taxonomy.character_placement: figure offset toward the right half of the frame, vertical center or slightly low, leaving breathing room on the left
border_frame_taxonomy.per_type_variation: Each RIASEC type uses the same frame family but a unique skew direction or corner emphasis so cards feel related yet distinct
